source: make a zombie apocalypse game where you have to survive waves where the zombies keep getting more and more. the setting is a ghost town and there is 3 zombie species, normal zombies (just fight) gold zombies (fight and cna levitate) and diamond zombies ( bigger and fights and fly) there is two circles on the right corner that say sprint and shoot. on the left corner there is gun, sword. and bat

answers.ask: Is this one main street to hold, or a whole town to move through between waves?
answers.answer: Use one main street in the ghost town as the small survival arena to hold.

answers.ask: Is there a wave you can win at, or does it run until you die?
answers.answer: It runs until you die, with each wave increasing the number of zombies.

- [scale] Is this one main street to hold, or a whole town to move through between waves? Use one main street in the ghost town as the small survival arena to hold.

config.genre_evidence: "survive waves" in "one main street... as the small survival arena to hold," with the game running "until you die" as zombie numbers increase each wave. Fighting with guns, sword, and bat is secondary Action.
config.evidence: "survive waves" where "zombies keep getting more and more," and clarification: "one main street ... as the small survival arena to hold"; hostile zombie types provide the AI threat.
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Survival map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Contained Arena: A clearly bounded space the round plays out in, keeping the threat and the player in meaningful proximity.

INCLUDE:
- Collapsing Structures: Multi-part buildings held together by structural welds so disaster scripts can realistically bring them down.
- Crawlspaces & Lockers: Small localized cutouts built into lower walls where players break enemy sightlines and hide. Minimum 4 studs on the entry axis (Part I §2).
